I built the compare-answers pipeline: a chat source sends each question to both `llm_openai_1` (GPT-4o-mini) and `llm_anthropic_1` (Claude), and a `response_answers` node returns both answers together. It passed `validate_pipeline` with no errors.

However, when I tried to run it, the engine refused to start because it couldn't find `ROCKETRIDE_OPENAI_API_KEY` in the environment (the node config correctly uses the `${ROCKETRIDE_OPENAI_API_KEY}` placeholder, as required — I never write real key values). The Anthropic node will need its matching `${ROCKETRIDE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}` variable too.

This is something only you or an org admin can do: please add `ROCKETRIDE_OPENAI_API_KEY` and `ROCKETRIDE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to the org, team, or user environment variables (or enter the keys directly in the node settings in the UI). Once that's done, let me know and I'll run the pipeline to confirm it returns both answers together.
